sources.title: ironSource / Unity LevelPlay playable ads
sources.notes: DAPI readiness, visibility, volume, resize and openStoreUrl host contract selected for the compiled adapter. Public documentation review is not an official test result.

sources.title: LevelPlay playable testing guidance
sources.notes: Official tool and physical-device runs remain separate acceptance gates.

uploadSize.notes: Conservative decimal 5 MB ceiling on the exact HTML upload.

packaging.notes: One self-contained HTML entry with inline assets.

inline.notes: DAPI is host-injected; no external script or navigation fallback is embedded.

mraid.notes: This target uses DAPI, not MRAID.

vendorHost.notes: Ready/viewableChange/audioVolumeChange/adResized subscriptions and dapi.openStoreUrl on deliberate CTA.

autoplay.notes: Local lifecycle safety policy; DAPI volume events scale the active mix.

firstClick.notes: Only a deliberate CTA invokes the host store method.

viewability.notes: The adapter queries initial viewability after readiness and subscribes to viewableChange.

orientations.notes: Both orientations are tested by local Creative QA.

value.instructions: Run the exact HTML through the current official LevelPlay/ironSource test workflow and on physical iOS/Android devices. Verify ready, viewability, volume, rotation, background/resume, end card, and one deliberate CTA. No official run is implied.

companionAssets.notes: Campaign assets and dashboard configuration are outside this artifact.
